title: URQL
description: A highly customizable and versatile GraphQL client.

data.text: URQL is a GraphQL client that emphasizes simplicity and customizability. It provides React hooks for queries and mutations and allows you to build your own client pipeline with exchanges.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install URQL and its React bindings.
data.code:
npm install urql graphql
# or
yarn add urql graphql

data.title: Basic Usage
Why URQL?
data.text: URQL's exchange-based architecture lets you add caching, authentication, and error handling as needed without paying for features you do not use.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: It uses React hooks by default
The exchange system enables custom behavior
data.takeaway: URQL is ideal when you want a flexible GraphQL client without the weight of Apollo.
